rules.name: 函数参数过多
rules.description: 函数参数过多会降低代码的可读性和可维护性。建议使用对象参数或者将函数拆分为多个小函数。
rules.description_en: Function has too many parameters which reduces code readability and maintainability

rules.name: 复杂的逻辑表达式
rules.description: 过于复杂的逻辑表达式会降低代码的可读性。建议将复杂的条件拆分为多个简单的表达式。
rules.description_en: Code contains overly complex logical expressions that reduce readability

rules.name: 文件行数过多
rules.description: 过长的文件通常意味着职责不够单一。建议将大文件拆分为多个更小的、职责单一的文件。
rules.description_en: File contains too many lines of code which suggests it might have too many responsibilities

rules.name: 完全重复的代码
rules.description: 代码重复违反了DRY原则。建议将重复的代码提取为共用的函数或类。
rules.description_en: Identical code fragments found in the codebase which violates DRY principle

rules.name: 方法圈复杂度过高
rules.description: 高圈复杂度通常表明方法逻辑过于复杂。建议将复杂的方法拆分为多个更简单的方法。
rules.description_en: Method has a high cyclomatic complexity which indicates it might be too complex

rules.name: 嵌套控制流过深
rules.description: 过深的控制流嵌套（if/for/while等）会显著增加代码的复杂度。建议提取方法或使用卫语句重构。
rules.description_en: Code contains deeply nested control flow statements which increases complexity

rules.name: 函数包含过多返回语句
rules.description: 当一个函数中包含过多的return语句时，会使得代码流程难以追踪和维护。建议重构代码，减少返回点的数量。
rules.description_en: Function contains too many return statements which makes the code flow harder to follow and maintain

rules.name: 相似代码
rules.description: 结构相似的代码可能表明存在可复用的模式。建议考虑重构以提高代码复用性。
rules.description_en: Similar code structures found which might indicate potential for better code reuse
